Ben — thanks for the notes and the MAP file. Quick summary from our side and recommended next steps (short + actionable):

Summary of recommended capacity (initial sizing):
- US-east dedicated pool (hosted / dedicated): 4x A100-80GB (inference-optimized) + 2x T4 for lower-priority batch jobs. Estimated sustained throughput: 85–95 TPS; burst to 160 TPS with short-term autoscale.
- Private VPC (PHI scope): 3x A100-80GB reserved (for predictable throughput) with an option for 1x spare A100 for failover.
- Fallback policy: route to hosted lower-cost variant (2x B100-40GB quantized) on capacity pressure for non-PHI traffic.

Performance estimates (preliminary):
- US-east (A100 pool): p50 ~22 ms per token, p95 ~65 ms (depends on sequence length / decoding settings).
- Private VPC (reserved A100s): target p50 ~25 ms, p95 ~75 ms; we include prefix KV caching to reduce repeat costs.

Action items from today's MAP checkpoint:
- Vivek: produce a region-sku breakdown with expected tokens/sec per GPU and batch profiles (due 2026-08-03).
- Laura: draft proposal language (commit + optional burst) for procurement and include a DocuSign-ready SOW (due 2026-08-06).
- Hannah (me): update the MAP workbook with these SKUs and the proposed timeline for close (target 2026-08-20).

I've attached an updated MAP worksheet (Orion_Health_MAP_v3.xlsx) with the sizing table and an initial cost estimate. We'll treat the Private VPC as separate line items in the SOW for clarity.

Propose a short tech deep-dive with Vivek and your platform team on Wednesday 2026-08-04 to walk throughput and failover mechanics. Is 10:00am ET workable?

Best,

Subject: Re: Dedicated & Private Capacity: MAP checkpoint and sizing forecast

Thanks — digging into the sizing. Notes and technical clarifications for the MAP:

1) GPU selection rationale:
- A100-80GB provides the best mix for long-sequence inference and large KV caches; single A100 gives ~20–25 TPS for our medium prompt profile (avg 1k tokens per request) when using FP16 with attention optimizations.
- T4s are cost-effective for batching rerank/low-priority workloads; we do not recommend T4s for primary PHI inference due to memory limits.

2) Quantization + model variant guidance:
- For hosted fallback variants use 4-bit quantized B100-40GB variants; quality delta is small for multiple prompt families we saw in your eval set.

3) Autoscaling and perf targets:
- Private VPC: autoscaling is supported but requires pre-approval in the SOW for dynamic GPU allocation; otherwise we provision reserved capacity with scheduled burst windows.
- Expected throughput (tokens/sec) per GPU (approx): A100-80GB = 22–26 TPS (medium prompt), B100-40GB quantized = 9–12 TPS. These numbers assume batching of 4–8 and typical sequence lengths from your MAP workbook.

4) Risks / mitigations:
- Risk: sudden long-sequence bursts causing p95 spikes — mitigation: prefix/KV caching + request-based routing to higher-memory nodes.
- Risk: compliance onboarding (SOC2 evidence) may delay Private deploy by 1–2 weeks — mitigation: start evidence package now; Laura to own.

I'll attach a short regional SKU breakdown PDF I pulled from our cluster benchmarks. This should help Laura with procurement language.

—Vivek
VP, Serving Runtime (Redwood Inference)
